property_summary: When Alice calls getBalance(Alice) after the contract is deployed without any balance, the reference version returns 0 (the mapping from the argument address), while the buggy version returns 0 only if msg.sender equals the argument (since it returns userBalance[msg.sender] ignoring the argument), but the concrete divergence will be shown with two different addresses: Bob calls getBalance(Alice) — reference returns 0 (no bug), buggy returns 0 (still 0 because Alice has no balance either). Actually the divergence is: reference getBalance(u) returns balance of u; buggy returns balance of msg.sender. For u != msg.sender with different balances, values diverge. Concrete scenario: fund Alice with 10 ether, then Bob calls getBalance(Alice) — reference returns 10, buggy returns 0.
